cardiac_arrest.title: 兒科心臟停止 Cardiac Arrest
cardiac_arrest.subtitle: AHA/AAP 2025 PALS Figure 2

yes.label: VF / pulseless VT
actions: Shock (1st 2 J/kg)
CPR 2 min + IV/IO access
Rhythm shockable？ YES → Shock (2nd 4 J/kg)
CPR 2 min + Epinephrine q3-5 min + 考慮 advanced airway + capnography
Rhythm shockable？ YES → Shock (≥4 J/kg, max 10 J/kg or adult)
CPR 2 min + Amiodarone OR Lidocaine + treat reversible causes
ROSC？ → Post-Cardiac Arrest Care；無 ROSC → 重複 shock-CPR-drug cycle

no.label: Asystole / PEA
actions: Epinephrine ASAP
CPR 2 min + IV/IO access + Epi q3-5 min + 考慮 advanced airway + capnography
Rhythm shockable？ YES → 接 shockable pathway (Shock ASAP)
Rhythm 仍非 shockable → CPR 2 min + treat reversible causes
再次 Rhythm shockable？ YES → Shock ASAP；NO → 繼續 nonshockable cycle
ROSC？ → Post-Cardiac Arrest Care；無 ROSC → 重複

energy_doses.label: Defibrillation 3rd+
energy_doses.note: ≥4 J/kg, max 10 J/kg or adult dose

high_quality_cpr: C:V ratio：15:2（2 救者 prepuberty）；30:2（2 救者 postpuberty 或 1 救者任何年齡）
Advanced airway → continuous compressions + 1 breath q2-3 sec

tachy_pulse.title: 兒科心搏過速（有脈搏） Tachyarrhythmia With Pulse
tachy_pulse.subtitle: AHA/AAP 2025 PALS Figure 7

branches.label: Probable SVT
branches.action: IV/IO Adenosine（若 access 已建立）OR Synchronized cardioversion

branches.label: Possible VT
branches.action: Synchronized cardioversion；後續藥物前 expert consult

branches.label: Possible VT 或 SVT with aberrancy
branches.action: Expert consultation 建議；若 regular + monomorphic 可考慮 Adenosine

energy_doses.label: Synchronized cardioversion 2nd
energy_doses.note: 若 0.5-1 J/kg 無效升至 2 J/kg；需要時鎮靜，不可延誤 cardioversion

tachy_pulse.refractory_note: Refractory SVT（cardiopulmonary compromise + vagal / adenosine / synchronized cardioversion 皆無效）且 **expert consultation 不可用** 時，may consider IV procainamide、amiodarone 或 sotalol

brady_pulse.title: 兒科心搏過慢（有脈搏） Bradycardia With Pulse
brady_pulse.subtitle: AHA/AAP 2025 PALS Figure 6
steps_initial: 評估 cardiopulmonary compromise（altered MS / shock / hypotension）

yes.label: YES
actions: Maintain airway + O2；PPV PRN
Cardiopulmonary monitor；持續 monitor pulse
Bradycardia 持續且仍有 compromise？
↳ NO → Identify and treat underlying causes；support ABCs；consider O2 / 12-lead；observe
↳ YES：HR <60 → Start CPR；IV/IO + Epinephrine；Atropine（vagal tone↑或 primary AV block 才用）
Identify and treat underlying causes；考慮 transthoracic / transvenous pacing
每 2 min check pulse
↳ Pulse present → 回「Bradycardia 持續且仍有 compromise？」
↳ No pulse → 跳 Cardiac Arrest Algorithm

no.label: NO
actions: Identify and treat underlying causes
Support ABCs；考慮 O2、12-lead ECG
Observe

se.title: 兒科癲癇重積 Convulsive Status Epilepticus
se.subtitle: AES 2016 · Glauser et al · Epilepsy Currents 16(1):48-61

actions: ABCD：airway / breathing / circulation / disability（含 neurologic exam）
計時 seizure onset + 監測 vital signs
氧氣 NC / mask；呼吸不穩考慮插管
Initiate ECG monitoring
Fingerstick glucose；< 60 mg/dL → ≥2 yr：2 mL/kg D25W IV｜<2 yr：4 mL/kg D12.5W IV
IV access + electrolytes / CBC / tox screen / ASM levels

time_stages.subtitle: 三選一（IM midazolam / IV lorazepam / IV diazepam）
actions: IM Midazolam（無 IV 時首選）：13–40 kg → 5 mg；>40 kg → 10 mg（single dose）
IV Lorazepam：0.1 mg/kg/dose（max 4 mg/dose；可重複 1 次）
IV Diazepam：0.15–0.2 mg/kg/dose（max 10 mg/dose；可重複 1 次）
若以上皆不可用：IV Phenobarbital 15 mg/kg（Level A，院內 2PHENO）／ Rectal Diazepam 0.2–0.5 mg/kg, max 20 mg（Level B）／ IN 或 buccal Midazolam（Level B）

time_stages.subtitle: 三選一，single dose
actions: IV Fosphenytoin 20 mg PE/kg（max 1500 mg PE）— 院內無 fosphenytoin，以 IV Phenytoin 20 mg/kg 替代（Aleviatin 2DPH，rate ≤ 1 mg/kg/min）
IV Valproic acid 40 mg/kg（max 3000 mg/dose）
IV Levetiracetam 60 mg/kg（max 4500 mg/dose）
若以上皆不可用且未給過：IV Phenobarbital 15 mg/kg（Level B）
重複 second line therapy；或
麻醉劑量：thiopental / midazolam / pentobarbital / propofol
皆需 continuous EEG monitoring + 插管 + ICU

se.decision_label: Does Seizure Continue? — 若仍持續 → 進下一階段；若已停 → symptomatic care
se.citation: Glauser T, Shinnar S, Gloss D, et al. Evidence-Based Guideline: Treatment of Convulsive Status Epilepticus in Children and Adults. Epilepsy Currents 2016;16(1):48-61.
